trust_decision.summary: Whether an anonymous holder of a share code may take one more pickup of a count/time-limited share; decided by a read-check (is_expired) followed by a separate non-atomic read-modify-save of expired_count/used_count, and not at all on the /share/download route or for direct storage URLs.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names views.py update_file_usage; it is the non-atomic decrement-and-save called from both /share/select/ handlers.

fix_sites.entry_point: helper consume_file_usage (replaces update_file_usage at apps/base/views.py:214) used by GET/POST /share/select/ and GET /share/download
POST /share/select/ (apps/base/views.py:292-302); consumes only when no proxy download URL is issued
GET /share/download (apps/base/views.py:305-320); previously skipped expiry check (check=False) and never consumed
build_select_detail via POST /share/select/; count-limited files get proxy URL instead of storage-backend direct URL (core/storage.py:384-399 S3 presigned, core/storage.py:722-730 OneDrive)
code generation default (apps/base/utils.py:93); separate issue #482 hardening, not the race
GET/POST /share/metadata/ rate limiter (apps/base/utils.py:128-131); separate brute-force hardening
GET /api/v1/config public config (main.py); unrelated issue #480 admin-address flag

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: apps/base/views.py:305-320 (GET /share/download: a second delivery path that never consumes and bypasses expiry via check=False at apps/base/views.py:312), plus the direct-URL producers in core/storage.py:384-399 and core/storage.py:722-730 reached via apps/base/views.py:245-247

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names update_file_usage and the race; /share/download is 'just the signed link the select step already paid for' and storage presigned URLs are 'the backend's concern', so making update_file_usage atomic looks complete.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Unlimited/time-limited shares (expired_count<0, incl. forever with expired_at=None) must still be picked up concurrently and increment used_count; and POST /share/select/ must not consume when it hands out a /share/download link, or a count=1 file is used up before it is downloaded (double count).

O6_input_shapes: time-limited share (expired_count<0, expired_at in future / past)
text share vs file share (text returned inline, file via storage URL or proxy)
local/proxy storage (/share/download URL) vs direct-URL storage (S3 presigned, OneDrive link)

O7_producer.where: apps/base/views.py:241-254 build_select_detail calling FileStorageInterface.get_file_url (core/storage.py:384-399, core/storage.py:722-730) which emits a reusable direct URL

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A legacy GET retrieval alias (e.g. an /api-prefixed copy of the share router) that returns content after its own read-check + save.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: main.py:764-765 already mounts presign_api twice for legacy /api clients; a maintainer could do the same for share_api with a copied handler.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A storage backend whose get_file_url returns a direct reusable link (like S3 non-proxy) without the proxy option, reached through build_select_detail.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The interface docstring at core/storage.py:44-51 explicitly allows backends to return direct URLs; S3 and OneDrive already do.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'share link preview' public endpoint reusing download_file-style direct get_file_response without consuming.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Admin download already serves file content with no usage accounting; exposing a preview publicly is a plausible feature.

O9_family: race condition / TOCTOU on per-share pickup limit (CWE-362), with an unconsumed second delivery path

O10_build.project_tests: unittest files under tests/ (e.g. tests/test_issue_473_retrieve_code.py exercises get_code_file_by_code); fix adds tests/test_issue_482_share_usage.py using in-memory sqlite Tortoise.init

j.j_sites_touched: apps/base/views.py, apps/base/utils.py, core/config.py, core/settings.py, core/tasks.py, main.py
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap update_file_usage in a lock or a select_for_update/atomic block (or move the is_expired check into it) and leave /share/download and direct storage URLs unconsumed.

out_of_scope_notes: Time-limited shares on S3 non-proxy still get a 3600s presigned URL (core/storage.py:397) that can outlive expired_at; the fix deliberately keeps direct URLs for expired_count<0.
Admin file update does a full-object save (apps/admin/views.py:594) that can overwrite concurrent used_count/expired_count changes; admin-only.
The bundled fix commit also changes code-generation default and metadata rate limiting (#482) and public admin-address flag (#480); unrelated to the race.
